asks.message: TRANEXTR STEP10 and STEP20 read AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.PS and AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANCATG.PS with DISP=SHR before STEP40/STEP50 create them, so the job depends on the files left by its own previous run; no scanned job creates them for a first run
asks.request: Confirm how the two extract files are first created (or that a first run is expected to fail at STEP10), and whether the job comment 'runs once a day' or the scheduler description 'WEEKLY' is the real frequency

notes.text: The job comment says TRANEXTR runs once a day, while the Control-M smart folder that schedules it is described 'WEEKLY TransactionTypesDBRefresh'; the two statements are not reconciled by any scanned source.

STEP1 runs CBTRNDYN through the DSN RUN command with PARMS('COBTUPDT') in SYSTSIN; the scanner looks for PARM= on the EXEC statement and records the parameter as missing, so the dynamic CALL target stays an open evidence request rather than being taken from this line.
